settings.question: What are your shipping and white-glove delivery timelines?
settings.answer: Standard domestic orders arrive within 3-5 business days. Express white-glove delivery is available for same-day dispatch on select metropolitan orders.

settings.question: How do I schedule a private atelier consultation?
settings.answer: Private appointments can be reserved directly through our concierge team by email or phone. We offer both virtual and in-person viewings.

settings.question: What is your return & exchange policy?
settings.answer: Complimentary returns and exchanges are accepted within 30 days of receipt for unused items in original packaging.
